evidence.title: AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in Tool-Rich Language Models

summary: The paper introduces AgentWeave, a framework that separates the routing decision from the reasoning process to streamline how large language models invoke external functions. By routing before reasoning, the method reduces unnecessary tool calls, improving speed and resource use while maintaining performance.
title: Researchers unveil AgentWeave, a routing‑first approach that boosts efficiency of function calling in tool‑rich language models
